name: Fiery Blaze Enchantments
summary: A rare black drake whelp's still-beating heart is needed for Fiery Blaze Enchantments in the Badlands. Sigrun Ironhew waits for word from Ironforge, and the whelps of Lethlor Ravine may supply what she needs.

sections.title: An Apprentice's Craft
sections.body: Sigrun Ironhew learned to kindle fire on weapons while apprenticed to Feranor Steeltoe. Feranor was last heard of among the smiths of a hunting party in Lordaeron. Sigrun waits in the Badlands for word from Ironforge. She has little else to do.

sections.title: The Whelps of Lethlor Ravine
sections.body: Sigrun shares little about the process. It calls for blood from the still-beating heart of a rare black drake whelp. Bring her a heart from a whelp in Lethlor Ravine, and she will show you the skill. The Scalding Whelps and Scorched Guardians there yield the hearts.

faq.q: Who taught Sigrun Ironhew this enchantment technique?
faq.answer: Sigrun learned the technique as an apprentice to Feranor Steeltoe. Feranor was last heard of among the smiths of a hunting party in Lordaeron.

faq.q: What component is needed to place fire upon a blade?
faq.answer: The enchantment calls for blood from the still-beating heart of a rare black drake whelp.

faq.q: Where are the black drake whelps found?
faq.answer: Black drake whelps are found in Lethlor Ravine, in the eastern Badlands.

faq.q: Why is Sigrun Ironhew lingering in the Badlands?
faq.answer: Sigrun is waiting for word from Ironforge and has little else to do in the meantime.

faq.q: Which creatures yield the needed heart?
faq.answer: The Scalding Whelps and Scorched Guardians of Lethlor Ravine yield the needed heart.

angles.text: Sigrun Ironhew waits for word from Ironforge, and this work is meant for the Alliance.
